notes: This initial European expansion covers three UK, one German and two Dutch businesses only. Bulgaria is in bulgaria.json and is not double-counted here.
All six businesses have independent websites. These are research/audit candidates, not a verified list of poor websites. An existing usable site may make replacement a low-priority opportunity.
A dealer's statement of 100-plus stock is a business claim, not a fresh count. Homepage make totals are derived observations. Neither establishes unique available vehicles or marketing consent.

Regional languages, units, pricing/tax presentation, legal notices and channels need market-specific review. Do not apply US email assumptions across Europe or treat corporate and sole-trader contacts identically.
No rendered mobile inspection, outreach, CRM migration or new project build was performed.

leads.name: AMH Cars Bhm Ltd

inventory.caveat: Sum of the retrieved homepage brand counts; refresh against the live available inventory before using as stock.

leads.evidenceNote: The homepage brand counts sum to 34 and include BMW and Skoda destinations with zero listings. Existing vehicle categories and catalogue functionality are present; the effect of zero-stock links needs rendered verification.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Stock-aware discovery that emphasizes available vehicles and keeps the mobile journey focused, rather than adding features already present.
leads.nextAction: Check the actual mobile stock journey and zero-stock link behavior. Qualify only if the proposed templates materially improve that experience.

leads.name: Midlands Trade Centre Limited
leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved used-car search reports 26 matches, below the initial 30-ad screening target. Generic error-dialog text in extracted markup is not evidence that visitors actually see an error.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Potential stock-first alternative only after scale and a concrete website gap are confirmed.
leads.nextAction: Keep on reserve; refresh current available stock and perform a visual/task audit before approving an exception to the initial size screen.

leads.name: Heartlands Motor Group
leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved homepage advertises 57 vehicles for sale and uses both Motor Group and Trade Centre wording. This may be intentional naming; verify it rather than creating separate accounts or calling it an error.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Consistent dealer identity and a concise stock-to-enquiry journey, assessed against the existing mobile experience.
leads.nextAction: Confirm the correct trading/legal names, current stock and specific mobile improvement. Preserve existing finance or other services only with verified terms.

leads.name: Autohandel Winter

inventory.caveat: The website describes 84 recorded passenger cars and treats the linked mobile.de listings as authoritative for price and availability.

leads.evidenceNote: The own-domain site displays 84 recorded cars, with individual cards opening the corresponding mobile.de listing. An owned homepage and searchable catalogue already exist; off-site details may be a deliberate choice.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Evaluate whether on-site vehicle details and a consistent dealer enquiry journey add value beyond the current marketplace handoff.
leads.nextAction: Audit actual mobile/detail behavior and confirm inventory-provider permissions. Review German channel-specific marketing requirements before any proposed contact.

leads.name: Autobedrijf Spinder

inventory.caveat: The business states more than 100 used cars and describes an additional location with 60. Do not sum these into an asserted 160-car verified inventory.

leads.evidenceNote: The homepage asks visitors to telephone to confirm which of two sites holds a car. This supports investigating location clarity, not a claim that the whole website is poor.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Vehicle-level showroom location and a clear viewing appointment path across the two sites.
leads.nextAction: Verify actual available stock, each vehicle's location and the current detail-page experience; then assess whether three template concepts solve a real location/enquiry problem.

leads.name: Autobedrijf Wester

inventory.caveat: More than 100 used cars is the dealer's homepage statement, not an independently counted live catalogue.

leads.evidenceNote: The homepage states more than 100 used cars and displays priced vehicle cards. The exact showroom city was not verified in this bounded pass; leave it null instead of guessing.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Investigate clearer mobile stock discovery and dealership presentation. No website defect has yet been demonstrated.
leads.nextAction: Confirm business/location identity, current stock and a concrete mobile or enquiry gap. Do not qualify from the 100-plus marketing statement alone.
